verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair axis for a cloud platform with programmatic access, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions versioned APIs, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The CLI, MCP server, and agent-skills evidence covers different stories and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
